sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. While as a family-run business we do not share internal cost breakdowns, we have recalculated our offer to reflect your preferred timeline. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

By maintaining the 30-day payment term, we are pleased to propose a revised price of €51.80 per unit. For our complete Angebot, we propose a price of €51.80 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and it is valid from 1 April 2027.

It is always a pleasure to work with valued partners who appreciate the craft and dedication of our foundry. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our long-standing business relationship.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your continued commitment to our long-standing cooperation. For decades, our foundry has taken immense pride in delivering the highest craftsmanship to trusted partners like Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. 

To support our shared future while safeguarding the high quality our regional team provides, we can offer a price of €50.80 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. We maintain the 30-day payment term, as this remains the most suitable option for our operations, bringing the full proposal to a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days. We trust this proposal reflects both our deep appreciation for our history together and our commitment to a strong, reliable partnership for years to come.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We appreciate your continued movement and your commitment to our long-standing cooperation. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in delivering reliable quality to our valued partners in the region. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We offer a price of €50.30 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. We maintain the 30-day payment term as it remains the most suitable option for our operations, bringing the Zahlungsziel to 30 days net.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
